Where should a small team start?
Pick one frequent task with a clear quality check, such as drafting responses to common enquiries.
Can AI guarantee better Google rankings?
Search rankings vary. Use AI to help research and draft useful content, then measure visibility and enquiries over time.
Can my team use existing tools?
Work with tools your organisation has approved and check the data, retention and access settings before running a pilot.
What does the readiness assessment collect?
Answers and scores stay in the current page. The assessment asks for no contact details.
What should I bring to an AI workshop?
Bring a common task, a safe sample brief and examples of good output. Remove customer details and choose someone to own the review process.
Where can I find free AI training in Brisbane?
Check Brisbane City Council’s business events for current workshop listings. Our [training page](/services/ai-training/) includes a self-paced exercise.
